text: GSLND[p,n,nb] denotes the negative component in the lightcone decomposition of the slashed Dirac matrix (\gamma \cdot p) along the vectors n and nb in \(D\) dimensions. It corresponds to \(\frac{1}{2} (n \cdot p) (\gamma \cdot \bar{n})\).
